changelog.summary: Independent update notifications for the desktop app, Migration Publisher and Generic CMS, backed by a shared QDN update registry.

desktop.changelog: Desktop startup update check with installed/latest versions, verified Debian download metadata, SHA-256 and manual install instructions. No automatic download or execution.

publisher.changelog: Publisher update badge and update view backed by the shared QDN registry. Existing handoff validation, approval gates and read-back receipts are unchanged.

cms.changelog: Generic CMS startup update check with a compact badge and update view. Preserves runtime qms-cms-config.json and never replaces the running site.
